record.title: SRO rulebook governance subject to SEC process
kv: Exchange Act section 19 proposed-rule process plus the SRO's effective rulebook.
A securities SRO's participant, membership, trading, clearing, or disciplinary rule is the claimed source of governance.
The Depository Trust Company (registered or chartered); National Securities Clearing Corporation (registered or chartered); Fixed Income Clearing Corporation (registered or chartered)
National securities exchanges acting as SROs; Registered securities associations; Registered clearing agencies with applicable SRO rule obligations

Identify the SRO and exact rule version. Confirm the rule's Commission filing/approval or effectiveness status as applicable. Establish that the entity, participant, instrument, and event are within the rule's scope.
An SRO's private operating rulebook is not a general federal statute, and a corporate or protocol rulebook is not an SRO rulebook merely because market participants use it.
The Depository Trust Company: SEC lists DTC as a registered clearing agency.
National Securities Clearing Corporation: SEC lists NSCC as a registered clearing agency.
Fixed Income Clearing Corporation: SEC lists FICC as a registered clearing agency.
